The detail

Built where it takes the hit

Attached thumb

The thumb is stitched to the body, which keeps it out of your partner's eye and holds your hand in a natural flat fist.

Wide wrist strap

A long hook-and-loop closure that wraps properly, so the wrist stays supported through a full round instead of loosening off.

Full-grain cowhide

Real leather, not bonded PU. It creases and softens with use rather than cracking along the seams in month three.

Why this page,
and not seven

What consolidating the Makari range into a single listing actually buys you.

The core change

One listing, eight colourways

Right now each colour is its own product, and the URLs show it: three of them end in "-copy" or "-copy-1". Every colour splits your reviews, your stock reporting and your search ranking eight ways. As one product with a colour option, the reviews pool, the page ranks once with eight times the signal, and a shopper who wants maroon in 14oz finds out in one click instead of leaving.

Sizing

The chart is text now, not a JPEG

Your size chart is currently an image in the gallery. Google cannot read it, screen readers cannot read it, and on a phone it is a pinch-and-squint job. As a real table it is searchable, accessible, and the fitter can highlight the buyer's row live.

The fitter

Answering the question at the till

Glove weight is the one thing buyers hesitate on, and hesitation at the size selector is where carts get abandoned. Bodyweight in, ounces out, applied to the selector in one tap. Same logic as the homepage finder, sitting where the decision is actually made.

Feature copy

Claims out of the graphics

"Attached thumb" and "wide hook-and-loop wrist strap" are good, specific selling points, and both are currently trapped inside image files. Lifted into HTML they can be read, indexed and skimmed.

Buy box

Price stays on screen

The buy box sticks on desktop and drops to a bar on mobile, so the price and the add-to-bag never scroll away while someone reads the spec. Standard on Nike and adidas, and it is worth real money on a £79.99 product.

What is placeholder

Swap these before it goes live

Review text and counts, the free-delivery threshold, and next-day dispatch are stand-ins. Product names, prices, photography and the size chart are all pulled from your live store.
